📖 Explanation:

To assist lower-budget teams during the expensive V8 transition, the FIA permitted the use of 2005-spec 3.0-litre V10 engines equipped with an air restrictor and a 16,700 RPM limit.

Scuderia Toro Rosso was the only team to utilize this concession during the 2006 season, running restricted Cosworth V10 engines in their STR1 chassis.
pending.question_text: When Formula 1 transitioned from 3.0-litre V10 to 2.4-litre V8 engines for the 2006 season, which team was granted a special exemption to run a restricted V10 engine?
